title: Auto Obby
script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Function to copy the game ID
local function copyTheId()
    local gameId = game.PlaceId -- get the Place ID
    print("Found game ID: " .. gameId) -- print it for checking

    -- Try to copy to clipboard
    local worked, oops = pcall(function()
        setclipboard(tostring(gameId)) -- copy the ID
    end)

    if worked then
        print("Copied game ID " .. gameId .. " to clipboard!")
    else
        print("Oh no, couldn't copy the ID! Error: " .. oops)
    end
end

-- Run it right away when the script starts
copyTheId()
